name: com.fortuday/almanac
title: Fortuday — Chinese Almanac, Lunar Calendar & Moon Phase
description: Chinese almanac, lunar calendar, Japanese Rokuyo, and moon phase calculator.

tools.name: get_almanac_day
tools.description: Compute pure-algorithm almanac details for any Gregorian date (1900-2100): Chinese Lunar calendar date, Sexagenary (Ganzhi) year/month/day pillars, auspicious (Yi) and inauspicious (Ji) activities in Traditional Chinese and English, daily zodiac clash & Sha direction, Twelve Duty Officer (Jianchu), auspicious daytime hours, solar term & festival, astronomical Moon sign & phase, Japanese Rokuyo & Koyomi notes (2026-2030), and Korean lunar Son-eomneun-nal status (1900-2049).

date.description: Optional Gregorian calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format (1900-01-01 to 2100-12-31), e.g. '2026-11-27'. Defaults to today in the selected timeZone.

timeZone.description: Optional IANA time zone name for Moon noon snapshot and default date, e.g. 'Asia/Taipei', 'Asia/Tokyo', 'America/New_York', or 'UTC'. Defaults to 'Asia/Taipei'.

tools.name: convert_solar_to_lunar
tools.description: Convert any Gregorian calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD, 1900-2100) into Chinese Lunar calendar date (year, month, day, leap month flag, Ganzhi year/month/day pillars, zodiac animal, solar term, festival) and Korean KASI Lunar calendar date (1900-2049, with Son-eomneun-nal spirit-free day flag).

date.description: Gregorian calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format (1900-01-01 to 2100-12-31), e.g. '2026-11-27'.
